name: vitality-health
description: Vitality Health — wellness PWA with a native companion app for background steps and watch sync

scripts.build: mkdir -p www && cp index.html styles.css script.js sw.js manifest.webmanifest www/ && cp -r icons www/
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
